# `lbt_data`

As OpenEMR 8.4.1's `sql/database.sql` creates it. Engine InnoDB. contains all data from layout-based transactions

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Extra | Comment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `form_id` | `bigint(20)` | no |  |  | references transactions.id |
| `field_id` | `varchar(31)` | no |  |  | references layout_options.field_id |
| `field_value` | `text` | yes | `NULL` |  |  |

## Indexes

| Index | Unique | Columns |

| `PRIMARY` | yes | `form_id`, `field_id` |
